name: Chip In
summary: Split a PKR bill equally or by hand, request each share with a real QR and watch the money come in
about: A bill splitter with a dark pay card. Set what it was for and the total, pick who was there and split it equally or type custom shares, which must add up before you can request. Request flies a coin to each friend; the pay card draws a real, scannable QR for each person's share, payments arrive one by one into the Collected meter and the card flips to All settled.
how: Type what the bill was for and the total in PKR.
Tap a person's badge to include or leave them out (You can be part of the split).
Choose Equal, or Custom and type each share; the note shows what is left to assign.
Press Request, then tap a friend on the pay card to see and copy their QR link.
When everyone has paid the card flips to All settled; start a new split from there.
